description: This PHP source file manages the editing of Home Security (HS) port forwarding rules in a web-based user interface. It includes server-side logic to retrieve existing port forwarding settings, generates an HTML form for user input, and embeds JavaScript for client-side validation and AJAX-based submission.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: A server-side function that fetches configuration values from a data store using a key prefix and parameter map.
